prayers.name: Bless
prayers.description: +10 to the next test of one type the target must make.

prayers.name: Fortify
prayers.description: +1 AP to all locations on the target.

prayers.name: Blessing of Battle
prayers.description: The target adds +1 SL to their first successful melee attack.

prayers.name: Blessing of Courage
prayers.description: Allies in range are immune to Fear and may reroll a failed Cool test.

prayers.name: Blessing of Tenacity
prayers.description: Remove one stack of Fatigued, Stunned, or Prone from the target.

prayers.name: Blessing of Hardiness
prayers.description: The target gains temporary Wounds equal to your Willpower Bonus.

prayers.name: Blessing of Wisdom
prayers.description: +10 to the target's next Intelligence-based test.

prayers.name: Blessing of Righteousness
prayers.description: The target's attacks count as magical and gain +1 SL against the unholy.

prayers.name: Blessing of Mercy
prayers.description: The target recovers 1 wound + your Willpower Bonus.

prayers.name: Calm Soul
prayers.description: Removes the Broken condition.

prayers.name: Staunch
prayers.description: Removes 1 Bleeding stack from the target.

prayers.name: Cure
prayers.description: Cures one disease. The target makes a Toughness test to throw off the worst of it.

prayers.name: Voice of Peace
prayers.description: Hostile creatures must pass a Cool test to attack anyone in range.

prayers.name: Heart of the Comet
prayers.description: Sigmar's courage fills you; +1 SL on melee attacks and immunity to Fear.

prayers.name: Soulfire
prayers.description: Holy fire scours the unholy; daemons and undead in range take damage and may flee.

prayers.name: Hammer of Sigmar
prayers.description: A weapon blazes with twin-tailed light; +2 Damage and counts as magical.

prayers.name: Comet of Sigmar
prayers.description: A blazing comet falls upon the foe, smiting all beneath it.

prayers.name: Heart of the Wolf
prayers.description: The fury of the wolf is yours; +1 SL on attacks and you ignore the Prone of a Charge.

prayers.name: Winter's Bite
prayers.description: A blast of killing frost; the target takes damage and may be slowed.

prayers.name: Last Rites
prayers.description: Commend a soul to Morr; the body cannot be raised as undead.

prayers.name: Walk of Dreams
prayers.description: Send the target into prophetic sleep; they wake with an omen or a glimpsed truth.

prayers.name: Shield of Myrmidia
prayers.description: A shimmering aegis; the target gains +2 AP on all locations against the first hit each round.

prayers.name: Tactical Insight
prayers.description: Allies act with one mind; each gains +1 SL on a single tactical test.

prayers.name: Speak the Truth
prayers.description: The target cannot knowingly speak a lie while the blessing holds.

prayers.name: Verena's Balance
prayers.description: Clarity of judgement; +10 to tests of reason, law, and seeing through deceit.

prayers.name: Ranald's Luck
prayers.description: Fortune favours the target; they may reroll one failed test before the blessing fades.

prayers.name: The Trickster's Coin
prayers.description: Sleight and misdirection come easily; +1 SL on Sleight of Hand and on tests to deceive.

prayers.name: Forest Stride
prayers.description: The wilds part for the target; they move through undergrowth without penalty and leave no trail.

prayers.name: Beast's Roar
prayers.description: A primal bellow; beasts in range cower or flee unless they pass Willpower.

deities.name: Sigmar
deities.dogma: Dogma: lead, defend, and sacrifice for the Empire. Hunt Chaos and the greenskins.

deities.name: Shallya
deities.dogma: Dogma: tend the dying, forgive the repentant, never deal a killing blow except against Chaos.

deities.name: Ulric
deities.epithet: God of Winter, War, and Wolves
deities.dogma: Dogma: show no weakness, never use missile weapons against a worthy foe, win by strength of arm.

deities.name: Morr
deities.dogma: Dogma: honour the dead, destroy the undead, never deny a soul its rest.

deities.name: Myrmidia
deities.dogma: Dogma: fight with discipline and honour, lead from the front, study the art of war.

deities.name: Verena
deities.dogma: Dogma: seek the truth, share knowledge, uphold the law without fear or favour.

deities.name: Ranald
deities.dogma: Dogma: rob the rich and proud, never betray a fellow rogue, keep your wits and your humour.

deities.name: Taal
deities.epithet: God of Nature and the Wild
deities.dogma: Dogma: respect the wilderness, take only what you need, protect the beasts of field and forest.

rows.effect: The deity is displeased; you gain 1 Sin point.
A divine reprimand. Stunned 1, and prayers cost +1 SL today.
You are struck mute. Cannot speak until end of scene.
Faith shaken: you lose access to prayers until you atone.
